profile.headline: Robotics Engineer
profile.summary: I develop planning and control algorithms for autonomous robots.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I help develop defense technology to make the world a safer place.

positions.title: Graduate Research And Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Developed planning and control algorithms for autonomous robotics applications, including autonomous driving, drone racing, and multi robot automated assembly.

positions.title: Autonomous Driving Intern
positions.description: I help develop algorithms and deep-learning models for intelligent decision-making in the context of autonomous driving.

positions.title: Crocker Innovation Fellow
positions.description: Studied and applied innovation principles in an interdisciplinary environment.

positions.title: MARS Rover Project Team Member
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented real-time vision system, graphical navigational interface, panoramic image capture device.
- Team leader for Astronaut Assistance mission at University Rover Challenge

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Developed computer vision software for use with handheld ultrasonic laser scanner. Built prototype handheld ultrasonic laser scanning system.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Developed "autolocalization" software to automatically map locations of piezoelectric transducers on a surface. Helped develop Dual Stage Structural Health Monitoring system to rapidly detect, localize and characterize damage in plate-like structures (specifically aircraft). Co-authored research paper and presented our research at IMAC 2015.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed Parametric Wingskin Generator--a software tool enabling rapid design and modeling of blended-wing aircraft aerodynamic surfaces. Designed aerodynamic surface for miniature blended-wing UAV, helped build and fly it. Tested and demonstrated multi-user CAD system (NXConnect).

educations.fieldOfStudy: Mechanical Engineering - Emphasis in Robotics, Machine Learning

honors.title: National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship
honors.description: The NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP) helps ensure the vitality of the human resource base of science and engineering in the United States and reinforces its diversity. The program recognizes and supports outstanding graduate students in NSF-supported science, technology, engineering, and mathematics disciplines who are pursuing research-based master's and doctoral degrees at accredited United States institutions.
honors.issuer: Issued by National Science Foundation · Mar 2016

honors.title: Barry Goldwater Undergraduate Research Scholarship
honors.description: $7500 per year for undergraduate students intent on pursuing advanced research in Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics
honors.issuer: Issued by Barry Goldwater Scholarship and Excellence in Education Program · Mar 2015
